posts.text: Happy birthday to… us! 🎉 To our incredible community, thank you for being part of Riftbound’s first year. To celebrate, we’re hosting a giveaway! Enter by sharing your favorite Riftbound memory using #Riftbound1Year! One lucky player will win: - 1x Origins Booster Display - 3x Origins Champion Decks (Jinx, Viktor, and Lee Sin)…
